title: Patient Financial Services Policy on Virtual Care Charges and Visit Prepayments
content:
What a patient owes for a Virtual Care encounter follows the patient's Patient Financial Account: an insured patient owes the visit type's copay, and a Self-Pay Account patient pays the visit type's self-pay price.

## Policy

1. **Insured patients.** An insured patient's encounter is billed to the payer where the visit type is billed to insurance, and the patient owes the copay of the visit type's copay class (none, primary or specialist) under the Patient Financial Account rules.
2. **Self-Pay Account patients.** A Self-Pay Account patient pays the visit type's self-pay price, charged as a self-pay visit fee on completion. Each Virtual Care fee charged, the self-pay visit fee included, is posted as a charge on the Patient Financial Account.
3. **Prepayment at request.** Where the visit type's prepayment-at-request setting is Yes, the price (for self-pay) or the copay (for insured patients) is collected when the encounter is requested and held on the encounter. Medicaid Managed Care Account patients prepay nothing.
4. **One prepayment per encounter.** One prepayment is collected per encounter. Whether a prepayment has already been collected is read from the system's record of that encounter before a prepayment is taken.
5. **What becomes of the prepayment.** The prepayment is applied to the encounter on completion, refunded within the visit type's prepayment refund period in business days on a timely or clinic-initiated cancellation, a queue timeout or an uncharged technical failure, credited toward the in-person visit on conversion, and forfeited toward a fee only on a late cancellation.
6. **Price shown.** The self-pay price is shown before the request is submitted where the visit type's price-display setting is Yes, and no other charge is added.

## The visit prepayment

The visit prepayment is the amount prepaid by a self-pay patient (or, for On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care, any patient's expected cost share) for one virtual encounter, held until it is applied, credited or refunded. A prepayment applied to the encounter appears on the Patient Financial Account as a copay collected by virtual prepayment; a prepayment credited on conversion or forfeited toward a fee appears there as a payment by virtual prepayment.

## Disposition of a held prepayment

| How the encounter ends | What becomes of the held prepayment |
|---|---|
| Completed | Applied to the encounter |
| Cancelled by the patient in time (timely) | Refunded within the refund period |
| Cancelled by the clinic (clinic-initiated) | Refunded within the refund period |
| Released from the on-demand queue (queue timeout) | Refunded within the refund period |
| Closed after a technical failure with no charge | Refunded within the refund period |
| Converted to an in-person visit | Credited toward the in-person visit |
| Cancelled by the patient late | Forfeited toward the fee |

## Who prepays, and what (visit types whose prepayment setting is Yes)

| Patient's Patient Financial Account | Amount collected at request |
|---|---|
| Self-Pay Account | The visit type's self-pay price |
| Medicaid Managed Care Account | Nothing |
| Any other insured account | The copay of the visit type's copay class |

On a visit type whose prepayment setting is No, nothing is collected at request under this policy.

## Worked cases (hypothetical amounts)

- A Self-Pay Account patient requests an encounter on a visit type that collects prepayment, with a hypothetical self-pay price of $50.00. The $50.00 is collected at request and held; on completion it is applied to the encounter.
- An insured patient with a hypothetical copay of $20.00 requests the same kind of encounter. The $20.00 copay is collected at request and held; if the patient then cancels in time, the $20.00 is refunded within the refund period.
- A Medicaid Managed Care Account patient requests the same kind of encounter. Nothing is collected at request.
- A second prepayment for an encounter that already has one collected is not taken: one prepayment is collected per encounter.
